title: mRemoteNG connection file
whyItMatters: mRemoteNG keeps saved RDP, SSH and VNC connections in confCons.xml, including stored credentials. A stranger could reconnect to the same servers.
source: mRemoteNG documentation, settings and connections file location under %APPDATA%/mRemoteNG - https://mremoteng.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
notes: confCons.xml is encrypted with a master password; installations that kept the default master password are readable by anyone. Portable installs keep the file next to the executable.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export the connection list from mRemoteNG without passwords if you need the host names.
cleanup.signOut: Change the passwords of the server accounts this PC connected to, because the saved copies keep working after the file is gone.
steps: Change the server account passwords at the hosting provider.
Uninstall mRemoteNG from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes saved connections and stored credentials from this PC. Server accounts stay usable until their passwords are changed.
